scope: Real client with synthetic fetch/stream transport

checks.name: Vault invalidation removes old active history and loads redacted content
Lock invalidation prevents late history response from repopulating cache
Reconnect refreshes subscribed history after missed changes
Client close aborts its pending ordinary backend fetch
A bounded backend deadline rejects a stalled request
An initial query deadline retries while the change stream stays connected
Idle, invalidation and close each cancel scheduled query retries
Removing the final subscriber cancels its pending request
